Bondar_2025_FlowECG.task_model: Diagnosis-conditioned S4 flow matching, retaining SSSD-ECG architecture; 71 binary diagnostic conditions (pp. 2–5, §§2.1,3.1–3.2).
Bondar_2025_FlowECG.data_protocol: PTB-XL: 21,799 recordings/18,869 patients; 10 s, 1,000 samples, 8 independently generated leads expanded to 12. Hold-out test stated, but fold numbers, split sizes and explicit patient separation unclear; normalization not reported (pp. 2,4).
Bondar_2025_FlowECG.metrics: DTW (Eq.3), feature-based 1-Wasserstein (Eq.4), spectral similarity 1/(1+mean PSD Wasserstein) (Eq.5), biased empirical squared MMD (Eqs.6–7), and neural function evaluations/NFE. Lead-average aggregation is stated, but Wasserstein also concatenates channel features; exact feature list, kernel/bandwidth, and DTW pairing are unclear (§2.3). Errors lower, spectral similarity higher; units depend on preprocessing. NFE is a computation proxy, not wall-clock latency.
Bondar_2025_FlowECG.losses: Velocity regression E||f_theta(x_t,c,t)−(x_1−x_0)||², x_t a linear interpolation of independent Gaussian noise and ECG; unit coefficient; uniform time sampling; generator network only. Adam 2e−4, batch 6; Euler inference (Eq.8, pp.4–5).
Bondar_2025_FlowECG.evidence: Matched-backbone comparison and NFE sweep, not an isolated regularizer ablation. Table 1 reports MMD 80.70→21.09 and DTW 73.49→83.96 at 200 NFE; lower DTW is better, so it worsens. Claims of improvement on three metrics conflict with prose acknowledging spectral worsening; retain table-specific comparisons, not the headline. 10–25 NFE performance is claimed from Fig.2 (§3.3).
Bondar_2025_FlowECG.utility_expert_privacy: No downstream classification experiment, blinded clinical panel, or empirical privacy attack reported. Privacy is motivation, not a demonstrated guarantee (whole main text).
Bondar_2025_FlowECG.reproducibility: Architecture and optimizer specified; uncertainty, repeated seeds and full metric implementation details not reported. Publication footnote says preprint not peer reviewed and proceedings version forthcoming (p.1); do not treat this as confirmed publication.
Bondar_2025_FlowECG.critique: Reviewer assessment: useful efficiency evidence, but NFE must be paired with time/hardware measurements; feature distributions and unpaired DTW cannot independently establish physiological validity.

Huang_2025_MIDT.task_model: SSSD-ECG with multiresolution mel-spectrogram supervision; diagnostic/form/rhythm groups and age/sex embeddings condition 12-lead generation (§3).
Huang_2025_MIDT.data_protocol: PTB-XL 21,837 records/18,885 patients; 10 s at 100 Hz; explicitly patient-level 17,441/2,193/2,203 train/validation/test (§4). Age bins [12,17,34,54,74], sex 2 classes (§3.2). Additional normalization detail not reported in inspected methods.
Huang_2025_MIDT.metrics: RMSE, MSE, SNR dB, Fourier distance, Hausdorff distance, SSIM; membership inference risk/MIR and nearest-neighbor adversarial accuracy/NNAA; mean/max absolute Pearson interlead correlation error; downstream AUROC with 95% CIs; qualitative outlier clinical-feature distributions (Tables1–4, Appendix A). Pairing/normalization and exact MIR/NNAA implementations are insufficiently specified. Paper marks MIR/NNAA lower as better; NNAA can be negative and is not simply classifier accuracy.
Huang_2025_MIDT.losses: L_total=L_MSE+beta L_MIDT (Eq.1): multiresolution mel-magnitude L1 discrepancy between true and reconstructed ECG. Narrative calls MSE both denoising and signal-pointwise error; exact target is ambiguous. Beta, STFT window sizes, hop sizes and mel-bin count not reported; do not invent them (§3.1).
Huang_2025_MIDT.evidence: Table2 average correlation error 0.140→0.042 (70% reduction, not abstract's 74%). Table4 synthetic-only AUROC 0.541±0.074→0.640±0.094; with 1 real fold MIDT 0.902±0.004 versus real-only 0.901±0.009. Large-real-data augmentation gains are small (Table3). Reported CIs and p<0.05 annotations lack clear run/test specification in these sections. Table1 MIR for MIDT 0.0081 exceeds gender variant 0.0036, contradicting prose calling MIDT lowest. Discussion makes further ablation/privacy-training claims without matching clearly specified training terms or tables (§5).
Huang_2025_MIDT.utility_expert_privacy: 8 synthetic folds plus increasing real folds, and 8 real folds plus 1–8 synthetic folds (Tables3–4). No formal blinded cardiologist experiment reported; visual examples are not a Turing test. MIR/NNAA are empirical proxies, not differential-privacy guarantees.
Huang_2025_MIDT.reproducibility: Analyzed arXiv v2. Missing loss coefficient and spectral settings prevent exact paper-only reproduction. Demographic conditioning and loss changes require separate ablation; no code inspected.
Huang_2025_MIDT.critique: Reviewer assessment: evidence supports testing spectral supervision, but internal numerical/narrative inconsistencies and underdefined privacy metrics weaken strong trustworthiness claims.

Sviridov_2025_cNVAE.task_model: Conditional hierarchical Nouveau VAE adapted to 1D ECG; mixtures of logistic distributions and dependent channels; generate 8 leads then derive 12 (§III).
Sviridov_2025_cNVAE.data_protocol: PTB-XL 21,837; Georgia 10,344; Ningbo 34,905 records. 12 leads, 500 Hz, standardized to 10 s; per-lead 2.5–97.5 percentile filtering; random train/validation/test splits, explicit patient grouping unclear (§IV.B).
Sviridov_2025_cNVAE.metrics: Downstream per-class AUROC (%) averaged over training-data fractions; visual waveform/nearest-real comparisons; matched GPU training budget 134 h on A100. No distributional FID/MMD evaluation reported in own experiments (§§IV–V, TablesVI–VII, Figs2–6).
Sviridov_2025_cNVAE.losses: Hierarchical VAE training is described through NVAE architecture and mixture likelihood, but an explicit complete ECG objective and KL coefficients/schedule are not reported. TableV lists 5-epoch warmup and zero normalizing flows; this is not enough to infer KL annealing. Comparator WaveGAN/Pulse2Pulse GP weight=10 (TablesII–III).
Sviridov_2025_cNVAE.evidence: Ablates 1D versus 2D architecture and augmentation strategy, not ELBO components. MI-only augmentation gain up to 1.8 percentage points AUROC; both-class gain up to 1.5 (§V.A). Rare-class transfer sometimes worsens versus real-only pretraining (TablesVI–VII). CIs/seeds not reported.
Sviridov_2025_cNVAE.utility_expert_privacy: Fixed real validation/test, synthetic proportions 0.1–1,1.5,2 for whole-data enrichment; 0.1–1 for minority enrichment; class-balanced synthetic pretraining and Georgia/Ningbo fine-tuning (§IV.A). No clinician or attack experiment; clinician validation is future work (§VI).
Sviridov_2025_cNVAE.reproducibility: https://github.com/univanxx/cNVAE_ECG (p.1), not inspected. Batch size 64 in prose versus 32 TableV; equations for limb leads contain a suspected typographical error. Preserve these discrepancies rather than silently correcting the paper.
Sviridov_2025_cNVAE.critique: Reviewer assessment: useful external transfer design, but adaptation on external data is not zero-shot external validation; split ambiguity and absent loss specification limit attribution.

Skorik_2024_SSSDnle.task_model: Conditional SSSD diffusion with separate present/absent label embeddings and a 1×1 folding convolution (§IV.B–C).
Skorik_2024_SSSDnle.data_protocol: PTB-XL 21,837, 10 s, 100 Hz, eight independent leads expanded to 12; retains amplitude, reports bandpass preprocessing. Folds1–8 train,9 validation,10 test; patient grouping follows dataset folds but not independently audited (§IV.A,E).
Skorik_2024_SSSDnle.metrics: TSTR/TRTS G-mean sqrt(sensitivity×specificity), F1, multilabel ROC-AUC; expert diagnostic accuracy and real/fake confusion matrix; convergence versus processed samples. Relation metrics and TSTS explicitly rejected as uninformative (§IV.D–V). Distinguish classification F1 from manifold F1.
Skorik_2024_SSSDnle.losses: Inherited diffusion denoising/noise objective described in diffusion background (§III); no new loss term. SSSD settings inherited; exact ECG-specific weighting not separately supplied. New contribution is conditioning, not a changed training loss.
Skorik_2024_SSSDnle.evidence: TableI PVC TSTR F1 0.338→0.561; AFIB F1 0.720→0.709 despite broader improvement language. TableII multilabel TSTR AUROC0.820, TRTS0.894. TableIII includes duplicated-positive baseline. Checkpoint study shows disease-dependent convergence and possible undertraining (TableIV).
Skorik_2024_SSSDnle.utility_expert_privacy: 200 ECGs (100 real/100 synthetic) for diagnostic reporting; 20 each of five categories. Separate 380-example detection test: 100 real/280 synthetic; confusion matrix 99,1,1,279 means 378/380 correct (99.47%). Text inconsistently calls 280 records additional to 100 synthetic; table denominator retained. Third physician for detection; years of experience/blinding details not reported (§V.B, TablesV–VI). No privacy attack.
Skorik_2024_SSSDnle.reproducibility: Reports difficulty reproducing original SSSD multilabel TSTR. Generated data/expert results promised; no code inspection. Seed uncertainty not reported.
Skorik_2024_SSSDnle.critique: Reviewer assessment: unusually direct evidence that reasonable downstream utility can coexist with obvious synthetic appearance. Real/fake detectability is not a privacy metric, despite the authors' privacy framing.

Lai_2025_DiffuSETS.task_model: Text- and patient-conditioned latent diffusion: separately trained VAE plus cross-attention U-Net; age, sex, heart rate and LLM clinical-report embeddings (Methods, Model architecture).
Lai_2025_DiffuSETS.data_protocol: MIMIC-IV-ECG 800,035→794,372 retained recordings; 12 leads, 10 s,500 Hz downsampled to1,024 points (effective102.4 Hz). Excludes missing demographics/undetectable HR; XQRS replaces abnormal RR values. PTB-XL21,799 external records processed identically (Methods, Datasets). Explicit generator patient-level separation unclear in these methods; downstream50,000/task split80/10/10.
Lai_2025_DiffuSETS.metrics: Net1D feature FID (Gaussian feature moment distance; Eq.12), k=3 manifold precision/recall/F1 (Eqs.13–16), conditional HR MAE bpm (Eq.17), paired text–ECG embedding cosine/CLIP score (Eq.18). No raw pointwise MAE for unpaired waveforms. FeatureDB average-wave evaluation in TableS1; detailed supplementary implementation pending. Net1D/contrastive encoder training corpus and independence insufficiently specified in main paper. Diagnosis classifier outcomes and cardiologist real/fake judgments plus text-condition correctness (Results).
Lai_2025_DiffuSETS.losses: VAE MSE reconstruction+lambda KL(q(z|x)||N(0,I)); lambda linearly annealed from0, terminal value not specified (Eqs.7–8). Latent diffusion noise prediction MSE (Methods, Eq.5). VAE pretrained separately; T=1000, beta schedule0.00085–0.012, latent4×128; optimizer LR5e−4,batch512 (Implementation details). KL expression printed with log sigma rather than an unambiguously conventional variance notation; use faithful distributional Eq.7.
Lai_2025_DiffuSETS.evidence: Table1 internal FID23.6, manifoldF1 .894, HRMAE4.15, CLIP .812. Without patient information HRMAE12.25; without VAE FID48.9. These are component/conditioning ablations, not isolated KL-weight ablations. External PTB-XL FID27.6/HRMAE6.73. No claim of cross-paper ranking.
Lai_2025_DiffuSETS.utility_expert_privacy: Minority augmentation versus real-only and weighted-CE baselines for normality,AF,PVC; 50,000 selected records/task,80/10/10. Two cardiologists evaluate50 generated+50 real ECGs;100 generated reports assessed for semantic correctness (76%). Expertise years, agreement and uncertainty not fully specified (Results, Turing test; Fig.3). No membership attack or formal privacy guarantee.
Lai_2025_DiffuSETS.reproducibility: Published full text analyzed, linked arXiv v1 retained as earlier version. https://github.com/PKUDigitalHealth/DiffuSETS and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15331141; no code inspection. Supplement-specific metrics remain explicitly incomplete until supplement retrieval.
Lai_2025_DiffuSETS.critique: Reviewer assessment: broad evaluation spanning distribution, coverage, conditions and experts; encoder dependence, split independence and privacy claims require stronger checks.

Zanchi_2026_Validation.task_model: Pulse2Pulse-style WGAN-GP generation of Brugada typeI ECG; six-level U-Net generator, convolutional critic (§II.C).
Zanchi_2026_Validation.data_protocol: 21 patients,95.2%male,53±14y; 15s–5min16-lead acquisitions at1kHz,100Hz Chebyshev lowpass/50Hz notch, downsample500Hz;10s windows50%overlap yield1,122 ECGs. Generate1,122 eight-lead records expanded to12; no independent held-out patient evaluation (§II.A–C).
Zanchi_2026_Validation.metrics: Visual median-beat/IQR overlays; RR,PR,QRS,QTc and P/QRS/T axes; Mann–Whitney tests with real features aggregated per patient. ED, maximum absolute error (paper's MAE, NOT mean), cosine distance, MSE,RMSE,NMSE,RMSPE, kernel MMD,KL,DTW; FID listed but explicitly NOT used. Real–fake median distances contextualized by real intra-/interpatient distances (§II.D–E,TableII). Metric equations in supplement, not main text. Expert accuracy,sensitivity,specificity,PPV,NPV,F1 (TableIII).
Zanchi_2026_Validation.losses: WGAN-GP named; paper calls it gradient clipping, although GP and clipping differ. Weight not given in main text; original hyperparameters inherited. Adam1e−4,batch32,2000epochs (§II.C). No loss ablation.
Zanchi_2026_Validation.evidence: Morphology p>.05 across7 features is non-rejection, not demonstrated equivalence. Expert accuracy50.6%, sensitivity62.3%,specificity39%,F1=55.04% (TablesII–III). n_real=21 patient medians vs n_synthetic=1122; dependence among synthetic records from same trained generator is unaccounted for.
Zanchi_2026_Validation.utility_expert_privacy: One cardiologist >5y experience,2244 balanced real/synthetic cases, blinded to prevalence (§II.E). No downstream classifier experiment; independent Brugada data proposed as future work. Linked seven-reader report Zanchi_2025_Brugada is not an independent cohort. Pairwise-distance checks are not membership inference.
Zanchi_2026_Validation.reproducibility: Framework and supplementary appendix are described; training and synthetic resources claimed, not executed. Dataset size and sample units distinguish21 people from1122 overlapping windows.
Zanchi_2026_Validation.critique: Reviewer assessment: strong practical use of real–real reference distances and patient aggregation. Failure to reject a difference cannot establish equivalence or no memorization; held-out patients and explicit equivalence bounds are needed.

Kong_2024_fGAN.task_model: PPG-conditioned attention-gated U-Net GAN for paired ECG waveform synthesis (§2.2–2.3).
Kong_2024_fGAN.data_protocol: 15 participants,9/3/3 disjoint train/validation/test subjects;40,675/11,276/12,796 training-length segments. Resample128Hz,4s windows with2s overlap; PPG0.4–8Hz,ECG3–45Hz filters,minmax[−1,1]. Evaluate10s windows with8s overlap (§2.1,2.5); external cohort not reported.
Kong_2024_fGAN.metrics: HR MAPE%=100/N sum|HRreal−HRgen|/HRreal; standard peak detector and count of HR extraction failures. Validation mean/SD across31 seeds; best-validation-seed testMAPE; active/inactive strata; visual ECG morphology (§2.5,§3,Eq.4).
Kong_2024_fGAN.losses: Original logistic adversarial minimax+0.1×paired L1 FFT-amplitude difference excluding DC. Generator minimizes both, discriminator maximizes adversarial term (Eqs.1–3). Time-domain paired loss deliberately avoided for PPG–ECG latency. Generator/discriminator LR1e−4/1e−5; updates5:1; baseline15epochs vs spectral11epochs (§2.4).
Kong_2024_fGAN.evidence: 31 seeds each arm: validation MAPE SD12%→3%; t(60)=3.04,p=.005; failure counts t(60)=2.97,p=.006. Best-seed testMAPE14%→12%, PPG detector15% (Figs3–5,Table1). Different epoch schedules are a residual confound.
Kong_2024_fGAN.utility_expert_privacy: HR extraction is utility, not disease diagnosis. No expert, privacy attack or independent external validation reported.
Kong_2024_fGAN.reproducibility: FFT coefficient and exclusions explicit, more seeds than most reviewed studies. Peak-detection failures reported rather than silently omitted. Dataset name verified from p.1 during final check; no source code inspected.
Kong_2024_fGAN.critique: Reviewer assessment: relatively direct evidence for one spectral term, limited to HR and a small healthy/wearable cohort; correct HR does not validate ST/QT morphology.

Pohl_2025_MultiBeat.task_model: Hierarchical single-beat diffusion, learned multivariate feature trajectory, then feature-matched concatenation for multiminute ECG (§III).
Pohl_2025_MultiBeat.data_protocol: MIT-BIH Supraventricular:87h/47subjects;normal/abnormal collapse,~100sample R-centered beats;10,000 synthetic beats/class store. Additional MIT-BIH Arrhythmia check AppendixF. Lead selection,sample frequency,patient-separated split and exact sample counts not fully specified in methods.
Pohl_2025_MultiBeat.metrics: Beat-average DTW,curve Fréchet,Euclidean,RMSE,MAE,MSE,PRD; per-timepoint KL,JS,MMD,Wasserstein,KS,mean/variance/skew differences (AppendixTableIV). Feature distributions and correlations for R/P/Q/T intervals/amplitudes (TableII); R-amplitude matching error mV/counts; downstream accuracy,precision,recall,F1,MCC (TablesI,III,V–VII). These averaged-beat errors are not individual unpaired fidelity.
Pohl_2025_MultiBeat.losses: Diffusion/feature-generator training objectives inherited or insufficiently specified; no complete weighted training equation. Eq.1 weighted squared feature discrepancy is an inference-time beat-selection cost, NOT a neural training loss. Matching weights not enumerated (§III).
Pohl_2025_MultiBeat.evidence: Synthetic feature-based abnormal-class F1 .479 vs BRIDGE .470 and real .778 (TableIII); normal-class .956 vs .222 and real .906. Thus large overall gains do not imply near-real abnormal performance. No CIs or seeds specified. End-to-end comparison limited to5beats due to memory (§IV.E).
Pohl_2025_MultiBeat.utility_expert_privacy: TSTR evaluated with balancedSVM,decision tree,naiveBayes,SVM. No blinded clinical or privacy-attack study. Long examples do not establish validated minute-scale HRV.
Pohl_2025_MultiBeat.reproducibility: Several unspecified choices in feature generator, split and loss; Appendix provides metric values and examples. No implementation inspected.
Pohl_2025_MultiBeat.critique: Reviewer assessment: useful separation of morphology and temporal structure, but preserve rhythm distributions and report reused-beat rates to assess diversity beyond concatenated duration.

Oladunni_2026_Complementarity.task_model: Q-CFD-GAN with complex latent coupling and time/frequency/scalogram decoders; includes waveform output (§IV).
Oladunni_2026_Complementarity.data_protocol: Mendeley multimodal ECG source;70/15/15 patient-level split asserted. 0.5–40Hz bandpass,baseline correction,amplitude normalization,1,000sample segments; STFT256 Hann/50%overlap and Morlet scalogram. Sample counts,lead configuration,Hz and cohort details insufficiently specified (§IV.B,§V.A).
Oladunni_2026_Complementarity.metrics: Embedding variance/excess-variance ratio; classifier-output KL plausibility gap Delta; relative reduction rho; mutual-information complementarity retention and gamma; RMS-energy deviation and kappa; P2P amplitude,spectral entropy and joint RMS/P2P plots (Eqs.1–4,15,TableIII,Figs3–6). Encoder/classifier provenance and MI estimator details unclear; dimensionless normalized scores are specific to this paper.
Oladunni_2026_Complementarity.losses: Eq.11/Algorithm1: adversarial+lambda1 CFD+lambda2 interference+lambda3 physiology; CFD aligns complementarity plus orthogonality penalty (Eq.9), interference matches energy (Eq.13), physiology penalizes QRS/ST discrepancy (Eq.10). Critic WGAN-GP. Eq.14 instead omits adversarial term and weights: unresolved inconsistency. Lambda values grid-searched but not reported (§V.B).
Oladunni_2026_Complementarity.evidence: TableIII variance .033 vs real .031; classifierKL .157 vs MI-GAN .214; complementarity retention .91 vs .56; RMS3.8% vs11.2%. No uncertainty. Loss-removal ablations listed in design but component-specific numerical results not clearly separated in TableIII.
Oladunni_2026_Complementarity.utility_expert_privacy: Classifier plausibility proxy, no reported TSTR or independent cardiologist panel; no empirical privacy validation.
Oladunni_2026_Complementarity.reproducibility: Unspecified dataset size, trained feature models, MI estimation and selected coefficients impede reproduction; preprint analyzed.
Oladunni_2026_Complementarity.critique: Reviewer assessment: proposed signal constraints warrant testing, but stationary loss conditions and classifier agreement do not by themselves establish clinical validity or the claimed mathematical necessity of complex latents.
